# Recreation Prompt
Recreate a mobile-first top-down survival evasion arcade game called `Dollhouse Hex: Tiny Terror Run`. Preserve joystick movement, grab, attack, enemy pursuit, pickup/held-item behavior, three-heart failure, score-on-kill, collection index, and restart flow. Present it as satirical killer-doll domestic horror: a babysitter tiptoes through a cursed dollhouse/living-room, grabs absurd cursed props, and uses short-range jabs against sneaky possessed dolls. Use procedural Canvas/CSS art: doll silhouettes, toy blocks, dollhouse facades, red ritual thread, stitched HUD panels, horror fonts, eerie SFX, and portrait-safe touch controls.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current Game Reality
- genre: mobile-first top-down survival evasion / pursuit arcade game on a large scrolling canvas.
- objective: move through the arena, grab collectible/weapon props, survive pursuing enemies, and defeat enemies for score.
- input model: virtual joystick for movement, two touch buttons for grab and attack, plus keyboard WASD/arrows and attack/grab keys.
- core loop: start run, spawn collectibles and hostile pursuers, move to collect a prop, attack nearby enemies with a cone/range strike, score on enemy defeat, survive until hearts are gone, restart.
- fail/friction state: three hearts; enemy contact removes a heart with brief invulnerability; zero hearts opens a game-over screen with final score and restart/menu actions.

## Protected Mechanics
- Continuous top-down movement with friction, camera follow, world bounds, joystick and keyboard parity.
- Grab radius, held item replacement, collection index persistence, and pickup feedback.
- Attack cone/range with cooldown, knockback, enemy HP, score +100 on enemy kill, chance to drop new prop.
- Enemy pursuit from world edges, speed pressure scaling with score, collision damage, three-heart fail state, restart flow.

## Remix Trajectory
The new public surface reframes the same survival/pursuit loop as a satirical killer-doll domestic horror chase: the player is a babysitter dodging toy-sized possessed dolls in a cursed living-room/dollhouse, grabbing absurd household/toy props and jabbing back at close range.
